Computer engineering brings together electronics, computers, operating systems, programming, networks, measurement, troubleshooting, and design. These notes collect useful explanations, videos, references, activities, and projects. You don't have to read everything in order.

## Find a topic

::: {.ter-path-grid}
::: {.ter-path-card}
### Foundations

Numbers, units, calculator skills, scientific notation, engineering notation, and measurement.

[Open Foundations](01-number-systems/index.qmd)
:::

::: {.ter-path-card}
### Basic Electricity

Charge, voltage, current, resistance, circuits, Ohm's law, power, and energy.

[Open Basic Electricity](02-basic-electronics/index.qmd)
:::

::: {.ter-path-card}
### Circuit Analysis

Series, parallel, and mixed circuits, Kirchhoff's laws, measurement, and troubleshooting.

[Open Circuit Analysis](circuits/index.qmd)
:::

::: {.ter-path-card}
### Computer Systems

Parts, power, POST, BIOS/UEFI, operating systems, RAM, storage, upgrades, testing, and benchmarking.

[Open Computer Systems](computer-systems/index.qmd)
:::

::: {.ter-path-card}
### Linux & Operating Systems

Install Linux, use the terminal, inspect hardware, diagnose networks, compare performance, and administer a computer.

[Open Linux & Operating Systems](linux-operating-systems/index.qmd)
:::

::: {.ter-path-card}
### Digital Logic

Binary states, truth tables, gates, stable inputs, switches, pull-ups, and pull-downs.

[Open Digital Logic](03-digital-logic-inputs/index.qmd)
:::

::: {.ter-path-card}
### Programming & Physical Computing

Programming, microcontrollers, sensors, actuators, and useful computer-controlled systems.

[Open Physical Computing](04-microcontrollers/index.qmd)
:::

::: {.ter-path-card}
### Explore Further

Engineering preparation, control systems, networking, Git and GitHub, data, machine learning, and other extensions.

[Open the Engineering Preparation Track](engineering-preparation-track/index.qmd)
:::
:::
